scope: Frozen v4 and baseline v3 replayed through production Go feature parsing, routing and composition. Fresh coding families were excluded from fitting; native-chat clock holdouts use previously examined conversations. No native text stream clocks are manufactured for coding gap tests. No actual chat token ground truth.

freeze.selection: Visible unclocked and provider-body prior selected on previous-data calibration only; fresh 407-family labels not used for fitting or selection.

visible_models.notes: Family-balanced nonnegative arithmetic fit with supported-model shrinkage. Only complete explicitly visible thinking with no usable native clocks. Not a tokenizer or provider counter.

body_prior.notes: Global coding-transfer prior for complete tool-bearing responses with entirely missing thinking traces and no usable native window or supported exact body fit. Explicit model/effort-independent published fallback, not inferred identity or chat token telemetry.

visible_duration.notes: Native-chat arithmetic duration fits for explicitly visible unclocked thinking. Use observed same-response text rate when available, otherwise a character-duration fit. Predict duration independently of coding token conversion; never infer model identity.

freeze.implementation_notes: Point parameters remained frozen. Timing and token support gates are independent; estimated thinking duration cannot exceed a trustworthy native window or the 600-second training duration domain.

fresh_reserve.selection: All remaining SHA256 ordered eligible components, excluding every previous study and previous independent reserve; target magnitudes never rank families.
fresh_reserve.cohort: Thinking-active connected coding families; not a random sample of chat usage.

fresh_context.scope: saved timer/structural conversation cohorts; all retained requests through fixed cutoff; read-only current catalog; per-conversation snapshots

fresh_turns.clock_semantics: Sender event to retained response events; requested_at is first retained response, never verified request-send time; tool spans are call to result observation

implementation_guards: Missing argument payloads leave required argument size unavailable, not zero.
Only a nonempty final text block stop can bound the visible thinking duration.
Every scalar replay tool argument was known; these guards did not retune fitted point parameters.

replay.path: production Go observe, evidence routing and estimation
replay.counting_unit: Version/evidence replay cases; includes the same source responses under multiple masks.
